content.title: HIGH AVAILABILITY
content.content:
- **Active-active load model**: All Ground Plex nodes in a Snaplex are active simultaneously. Incoming pipeline execution requests are distributed across available nodes. Node failure is detected within the 20-second heartbeat interval; failed nodes are removed from the active pool and pending work is redistributed to healthy nodes via the Snaplex-native load-balancing mechanism — without administrator intervention or external tooling.

- **No single point of failure**: The Ground Plex execution layer has no single point of failure when deployed with 2+ nodes. The SnapLogic Manager (cloud) is operated by SnapLogic via a resilient SaaS architecture; Airbus Helicopters' Ground Plex on-premises installation does not depend on Manager availability for execution.

- **Scheduled pipeline resilience**: Scheduled pipelines that are interrupted by a node failure are automatically restarted on available nodes within the same Snaplex.
